summary: commitPendingUpdate hardcodes the "chore(flume): ..." commit-message text with no chain override point - a non-Flume-convention chain can't choose its own ship-commit message.

tests.asserts: a DispatcherOptions-supplied commit-message override lands verbatim in the pending.json ship commit; omitting the option reproduces today's exact 'chore(flume): ship ...' / 'chore(flume): record merge-failure footprints for ...' text

acceptance: A chain can override the pending-ledger ship-commit message text; default (no override) behavior is byte-identical to today; tsc/vitest green.
notes: Verified on disk this tick: Dispatcher.ts:2303-2310 hardcodes "chore(flume): ship ..." / "chore(flume): record merge-failure footprints..." with no override. job.ts:208/340 (re-verified post-JOB-EXTRACT-REMOVED) carry the identical literal but sit outside this neighborhood - a later sweep, not this entry's scope.
